detail.title: Refined Coarse-Grained Dissipation Bounds and Finite Relaxation
detail.summary: This revision formalizes how coarse-graining necessitates the use of lower bounds for entropy production retrieval, while trajectory-level inference provides a pathway for evaluating thermodynamic costs in nonequilibrium systems. The integration of variational expressions and coarse-grained data analysis clarifies the gap between ideal Landauer limits and practical information engine operation.
detail.reason: Notebook update incorporates recent literature on coarse-graining limits and variational inference methods, fulfilling the project commitment.
